payload.core_composition_summary: Sort items and gaps, then greedily merge intervals based on gap limits to compute max total for all k.
payload.rationale: Solution uses sorting to order items and gaps, then a greedy sweep merging intervals using DSU to precompute answers, combining sorting and greedy strategies.
